candidates.change_summary: Remove the require statement in the onlyOwner modifier, allowing anyone to call functions protected by it.
Delete the transfer statement so withdraw does nothing, causing withdraw to leave the balance unchanged.
Replace the transfer amount with zero so no funds are actually sent.
Replace the recipient with the contract address so the funds stay in the contract.
Remove the onlyOwner modifier body check so anyone can call withdraw.
Change the onlyOwner check to require(msg.sender != owner) so only non-owners can withdraw, causing a revert for the real owner.
Remove the require/revert failure check, so execution always succeeds even when the external call fails.
Replace the external call with a simple transfer, changing the gas stipend and error handling semantics.
Remove the entire body of sendMoney so it becomes a no-op and no funds are ever sent.
Remove the onlyOwner modifier body so that any caller can invoke sendMoney, altering who can cause transfers.
